title: 把重心挪到另一边
description: 成人双手轻扶稳定墙面，宽站姿小幅左右移重心。

art_direction.medium: editorial geometric illustration with credible adult proportions
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult stands in a comfortably wide stance facing a plain wall, fingertips touching it for balance. One knee bends a little as the pelvis shifts sideways, while the opposite knee remains softly extended rather than forced straight. Keep both heels grounded and the movement shallow. The view from behind at a modest angle makes the side shift clear, with an uncluttered warmup floor and muted gym architecture. Use dry-brush acrylic illustration with blocky forms, textured edge transitions, and a clear gray-green, persimmon, and cream palette. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
